title: Firefighter I Academy (South Bay JPA)
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Firefighter I Academy (South Bay JPA) Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate effective and safe operation of fire service tools and equipment.
Identify and properly use various fire appliances and nozzles and demonstrate effective hose rolling techniques.
Identify, maintain, and utilize various types of ladders used in the fire service.
Demonstrate proficiency in the donning and doffing of self-contained breathing apparatus.
Identify various forcible entry tools and describe their use.
Operate within the Incident Command System (ICS).
Apply appropriate critical thinking and skills in the assessment of illness and/or injury of a person involved in an emergency situation and apply emergency treatment principles and techniques.

notes: The page prints the total as 24.25 units ('Units: 24.25' and '(Total 24.25)'), but the requirements heading reads 'Firefighter I Academy (South Bay JPA) Certificate (24.5 units)'. total_units records 24.25, which matches the course sum (22.25 + 2). The 24.5 in the heading appears to be a typo.
The catalog prints the codes without a space (FIR170D, FIR150N). They are matched to the closed-list entries FIR 170D and FIR 150N.
The catalog prints FIR170D at 22.25 units; the state file stores 22.3 units, likely a rounding of the same figure.

Careers: 'fire service' is taken from 'prepares students for entry-level employment in the fire service'. Firefighter I is mentioned only as a State Fire Marshal certification, so it is not recorded as a career.
Grade of B or better is required in all courses.
The source URL slug references 'summer-2025' while the catalog year is 2026-2027; a reviewer may wish to confirm the catalog year.
